top_findings.title: ?author= filter never works over HTTP — wrap-params middleware is missing
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api/core.clj:37 reads (get-in request [:query-params "author"]), but the handler at src/book_api/core.clj:59-61 wraps only wrap-json-body + wrap-json-response; ring.middleware.params/wrap-params is absent (ring-core is a dep in deps.edn:3 but never required), so the Jetty adapter populates :query-string, never :query-params. The author arg is always nil → db/list-books returns every book. The db-layer filter at src/book_api/db.clj:49-52 is correct but unreachable with a real author value. The filter test at test/book_api/core_test.clj:34 hand-injects :query-params and calls core/app directly, bypassing the middleware stack, so it passes with false confidence.
top_findings.suggestion: Add ring.middleware.params/wrap-params to the handler threading in core.clj, and test through core/handler (with :query-string) rather than core/app with a pre-populated :query-params.
